'''Marlello duck eggs''' were [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] produced by the [[marlello]] [[Duck/Legends|duck]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]]. The giant eggs were part of a [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick's]] [[Diet/Legends|diet]] as their snouts were perfectly designed to puncture the shell and suck out of the yolk.<ref name="EGTAS" />

Marlello eggs could also be consumed by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and could be bought in grocery stores on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] once delivered stocks of marlello eggs to [[Clan Skirata]]'s home on [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="501st" />
